fixes.target: figure-1: Tools and accessories providing for effective dust removal
fixes.value: A photo of an angle grinder seen from below, lying on a dusty concrete floor. Its grinding disc has a ring of holes so dust can be drawn through it, and a dust extraction hose is attached to the hood around the disc. There are no printed labels.
fixes.reason: The photo matches the caption about tools and accessories for effective dust removal.
fixes.evidence: Image shows grinder, side handle, perforated disc, black extraction hose.

fixes.target: figure-2: Examples of captor hoods on a grinder and breaker
fixes.value: A photo of a breaker with an orange captor hood fitted around its chisel bit, connected to a black extraction hose. The chisel is resting on a dusty concrete surface with broken pieces nearby. There are no printed labels in the photo.
fixes.reason: The caption speaks of a grinder and a breaker, but the crop shows only the breaker; it also includes text from the next column (Figure 3 caption and How to choose the right one).
fixes.evidence: Image left half shows breaker hood; right half is page text.

fixes.target: figure-3: Examples of different extraction units
fixes.value: A photo of a yellow and black mobile extraction unit on wheels, standing against a wall. It has power sockets on the front, a yellow plug connected by a cable, and a black hose attached at the bottom. A warning label is visible on top but its words cannot be read.
fixes.reason: The caption says examples of different extraction units, but only one unit is visible in the crop.
fixes.evidence: Image shows one yellow vacuum-type extraction unit.

fixes.target: figure-4: Examples of labels on H and M class extraction units
fixes.value: A photo of a label on an extraction unit, with a red and white striped border. The label shows a large letter M at each end, with a dust hazard symbol, a warning triangle with an exclamation mark, and a symbol of an open book with the letter i between them.
fixes.reason: The caption mentions H and M class labels, but the crop shows only the M class label; it also includes bullet text from the next column.
fixes.evidence: Image left part shows the M label; right part is page text.
